definitions.explanation: Goods that remain unsold after others have been bought.

examples.japanese: {売|う}れ{残|のこ}りのパンを{安|やす}く{買|か}った。
セールの{後|あと}は{売|う}れ{残|のこ}りばかりだ。
examples.english: After the sale, there's nothing but unsold stock.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}{間際|まぎわ}になると、{売|う}れ{残|のこ}りの{弁当|べんとう}に{割引|わりびき}シールが{貼|は}られる。
examples.english: As closing time nears, discount stickers are put on the unsold boxed lunches.

notes:
The noun form of {売|う}れ{残|のこ}る (to remain unsold). Refers to merchandise left over after sales.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}りの{商品|しょうひん}: unsold merchandise
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}りを{処分|しょぶん}する: to clear out unsold stock
- {売|う}れ{残|のこ}りの{在庫|ざいこ}: leftover inventory

USAGE:
Applied to a person — especially an unmarried woman past a certain age — {売|う}れ{残|のこ}り is rude and outdated. Avoid this use.
